summary: Independent hold on p072 is correct. Owner agrees and proposes narrowing fabricated Chinese name surfaces. Approve preferred-name zh nulling and removal of non-quotable zh from the descriptive-kinship claim; amend full alias retraction to en-only descriptive-kinship so compact schema keeps at least one name claim. Identity primary-name certification for p072 remains blocked; entailed kinship record and family claims citing 祖父 are preserved.

units.enIdiomatic: Xu Man came from Pingyu in Runan.

units.zh: 祖父峻，字季山，善卜占之术，多有显验，时人方之前世京房。
units.enIdiomatic: His grandfather Xu Jun, styled Jishan, excelled at yarrow divination and racked up striking hits; contemporaries likened him to the Jing Fang of old.
units.entailedGeneration: 祖父 links Xu Jun (峻/季山) to Xu Man without naming the intervening father generation

closedCases.outcome: Agree with independent hold and owner agree-hold. p072 remains an entailed unnamed father generation; extraction must not attribute quotable Chinese personal names absent from s0045.
